import urllib.request, json
req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.openalex.org/works/doi:10.1016/s0896-6273(02)00679-7', headers={'User-Agent':'research-bot'})
d = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read())
print('open_access:', d.get('open_access'))
print('best_oa_location:', d.get('best_oa_location'))
print('primary_location:', d.get('primary_location'))
print('abstract_inverted_index keys:', list((d.get('abstract_inverted_index') or {}).keys())[:10])
